sourceTitle: The Harvest of the Sea A contribution to the natural and economic history of the British food fishes
description: "The Harvest of the Sea" by James G. Bertram is a scientific publication written in the mid-19th century. The work focuses on the natural and economic history of British food fishes, exploring various species, their life cycles, and the fishing industries associated with them.
